newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Visitor arrivals in Hong Kong up 19 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Visitor arrivals in Hong Kong up 19 pct in August.

text.p: The number of foreign visitors to Hong Kong reached 1.08 million in August, an increase of 18.9 percent over the same period last year, the Hong Kong Tourism Association said on Tuesday.
In the first eight months of the year, Hong Kong had 7.53 million visitors, a jump of 16.2 percent from the same period last year, it said.

Arrivals from north Asia rose 23.4 percent in August, accounting for 22.7 percent of total arrivals, while south and southeast Asian visitors rose 21.4 percent, accounting for 13.5 percent. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
